name: How long does it typically take to install a kitchen island?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a kitchen island?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a kitchen island can vary significantly. A simple, pre-fabricated island without utility connections might take only a day or two. However, custom islands involving plumbing for sinks, electrical for outlets or appliances, or complex structural modifications could extend the process to several days or even a week. We provide a detailed project schedule outlining each phase, from demolition (if needed) to final installation, during the planning stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time ranges from a day for simple islands to several days or a week for custom designs with utility connections.
